name: Deconfig
description: Developer module for excluding some configuration from import/export.
project_description: Deconfig lets a developer exempt selected configuration keys (or whole config objects) from Drupal's configuration import/export, so a site administrator can change those settings without them being overwritten on the next config sync. Exemptions are declared inline in the sync-storage YAML via a `_deconfig` entry that mirrors the config hierarchy, keeping the exclusion visible in code review and next to the setting it affects. It works by decorating the `config.storage.sync` service with a storage wrapper (Drupal\deconfig\DeconfigStorage) that reads deconfig'ed items from active storage instead of sync, so they always appear up to date and are never rewritten on export. As a safety measure the hidden item must not be present in sync storage; if it is, import/export throws so the drift is obvious, and a soft mode (an `@` prefix on the key) lets a default value stay in sync but be used only when active storage has no value. A Drush command, `deconfig-remove-hidden` (alias `drh`), cleans stray hidden config out of sync storage.
